claims.claimText: UBC teaching guidelines recognize that GenAI can sometimes support learners with disabilities through visual or audio formats, captions, image alternative text, and help with focus or organization. These potential benefits do not by themselves establish an individual assessment accommodation or permission to use GenAI.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: In some cases, GenAI can support inclusion, accessibility, and other ethical considerations. For example, GenAI tools can support learners with disabilities by being used to produce information in visual or audio formats in addition to text, to create captions for videos and alternative text for images, to help with focus and organization of writing or other tasks, and more.
